# `kernel/arch/vax/stand` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel (standalone boot code)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel (standalone boot code).

`config.mk` records 8 source file(s) here: `boot.c`, `bootxx.c`, `confxx.c`, `kdb.c`, `qdcons.c`, `qfont.c`, `qvcons.c`, `tmscp.c`.

Subdirectories: `libsa/`, `libsmsa/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的机器相关代码（独立引导代码）。

`config.mk` 记录了 8 个源文件：`boot.c`、`bootxx.c`、`confxx.c`、`kdb.c`、`qdcons.c`、`qfont.c`、`qvcons.c`、`tmscp.c`。

子目录：`libsa/`、`libsmsa/`。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
